# Snapshot generated from CLI documentation — will be replaced by CI on first run
# Tool: go-blueprint
# Command: go install github.com/melkeydev/go-blueprint@latest && go-blueprint --help

go-blueprint is a CLI tool to scaffold Go HTTP projects

Usage:
  go-blueprint [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  create      Create a new Go project
  help        Help about any command
  version     Display the version of go-blueprint

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for go-blueprint

Use "go-blueprint [command] --help" for more information about a command.
